brave-search.description: Allows AI agents to search the live web for statistics, datasets, and domain context.

fetch.description: Allows AI agents to read raw HTML/JSON from any URL. Use for scraping quick datasets.

sqlite.description: Allows AI agents to run SQL queries directly on the SQLite database.

github.description: Allows AI agents to search GitHub repos, read code, and create issues.

filesystem.description: Allows AI agents to read and write files in the workspace.
